name: inspire-marketplace
description: One-repo marketplace distributing the `inspire` plugin. `/plugin marketplace add skqr/claude-inspire-plugin` then `/plugin install inspire@inspire-marketplace`.

plugins.name: inspire
plugins.description: Mine a batch of links — YouTube videos and web articles — for what the current project can learn and apply: a read-only, prompt-injection-aware subagent per link over a bundled content MCP, synthesized into docs/inspiration/; then /apply promotes the vetted leads into the project's own docs, write-confined by a guard hook.
